findings.title: Wrong event listener removed in dispose
findings.body: The `dispose` method removes the `"message"` event listener bound to `this.onMessage` instead of the `"close"` event listener bound to `this.onMessage`. This leaves the `"close"` event listener attached, which can cause the callback to run after the socket is closed and lead to unexpected behavior or memory leaks.

summary.problem: The `dispose` method incorrectly removes the wrong event listener, leaving a dangling listener that can cause runtime issues.
summary.done_well: The file follows a clear structure for managing socket event listeners and cleanup.
